title: Monoxide
description: Monoxide adds consistency to blocks and items for a cleaner visual experience.
body:
## Monoxide
### The Consistency Pack

Monoxide adds consistency and tweaks to blocks and items for a cleaner visual experience.

currently,
Monoxide adds consistency for:
- Bricks
- Metal Blocks
- Gem Blocks
- Coal Items
- Stone
- Raw Ore Blocks
- Raw Ore Items
- Armor Sets _[still somewhat messy]_
- Cobbled Blocks _[includes resin, packed mud and more]_
- Nuggets
- Ingots
- Wooden Planks
- Vines (Glow lichen)

Monoxide tweaks:
- Concrete and Terracotta are solid colors rather than textured blocks
